resolved.title: 格式化字符串
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Formatting[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Strings have a [b]format()[/b] function, which enables values to be embedded in it, using placeholders.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3939"]nums = [4, 5, 6]
msg = "Numbers: {0} {1} {2}". [b]format[/b](nums[0], nums[1], nums[2])
print(msg)[/code]

[note]Each argument of the [b]format [/b]function is placed in the string at the corresponding position, which is determined using the curly braces { }.[/note]

resolved.title: 字符串函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Another lightning round! Here are some of the other useful string functions:

[b]join [/b]- joins a list of strings with another string as a separator.

[b]replace [/b]- replaces one substring in a string with another.

[b]startswith [/b]and [b]endswith[/b] - determine if there is a substring at the start and end of a string, respectively.

[b]lower [/b]and [b]upper [/b]– changes the case of a string

[b]split -[/b]the opposite of [b]join[/b], turns a string with a certain separator into a list.
[s0l0!-header][b]Here they are in action:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3941"]print(", ".[b]join[/b](["spam", "eggs", "ham"]))
#prints "spam, eggs, ham"

print("Hello ME".[b]replace[/b]("ME", "world"))
#prints "Hello world"

print("This is a sentence.".[b]startswith[/b]("This"))
# prints "True"

print("This is a sentence.".[b]endswith[/b]("sentence."))
# prints "True"

print("This is a sentence.".[b]upper[/b]())
# prints "THIS IS A SENTENCE."

print("AN ALL CAPS SENTENCE".[b]lower[/b]())
#prints "an all caps sentence"

print("spam, eggs, ham".[b]split[/b](", "))
#prints "['spam', 'eggs', 'ham']"[/code]
[note][b]Run the code[/b] and see how it works![/note]

content.text:
下面是其他一些有用的字符串函数：

**join** - 将字符串列表中的元素连起来

**replace** - 替换

**startswith** - 判断字符串是否以某个字符串开始

**endswith** - 判断字符串是否以某个字符串结束

**lower** - 将字符串变为小写

**upper** - 将字符串变为大写

**split** - 根据分隔符分割字符串为字符串列表

示例如下：
content.text_html:
Another lightning round! Here are some of the other useful string functions:

**join **- joins a list of strings with another string as a separator.

**replace **- replaces one substring in a string with another.

**startswith **and endswith - determine if there is a substring at the start and end of a string, respectively.

**lower **and **upper **– changes the case of a string

**split -**the opposite of join, turns a string with a certain separator into a list. Here they are in action:

又是一轮闪电!下面是其他一些有用的字符串函数。

**join **- 连接一个以另一个字符串为分隔符的字符串列表。

**replace **- 用一个字符串中的一个子串替换另一个。

**startswith ** 和 endswith - 分别确定在一个字符串的开头和结尾是否有一个子串。

**lower ** and **upper **- 改变一个字符串的大小写。

split -*与join相反，将一个有特定分隔符的字符串变成一个列表。 下面是它们的作用：。

content.content:
print(", ".join(["spam", "eggs", "ham"]))
#prints "spam, eggs, ham"

print("Hello ME".replace("ME", "world"))
#prints "Hello world"

print("This is a sentence.".startswith("This"))
# prints "True"

print("This is a sentence.".endswith("sentence."))
# prints "True"

print("This is a sentence.".upper())
# prints "THIS IS A SENTENCE."

print("AN ALL CAPS SENTENCE".lower())
#prints "an all caps sentence"

print("spam, eggs, ham".split(", "))
#prints "['spam', 'eggs', 'ham']"

resolved.title: 大写转小写
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你的朋友给你发了一条短信，但是他的大写字母锁坏了，整条短信都是大写的。

大写的文本很难阅读，所以你决定写一个程序，将文本转换为小写并输出。

以一个字符串为输入，以小写字母输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]String Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Your friend is sending you a text message, however his caps lock is broken and the whole message is in uppercase. 
Noone likes being shouted at, plus uppercase text is hard to read, so you decide to write a program to convert the text to lowercase and output it.

Take a string as input and output it in lowercase.

[note]Strings have useful function that convert the case.[/note]

resolved.question_text:

```typein
b = a.__0__()
```
